Name: More Monster Drops loot and looting (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

Mod rename From "My Unique Skill Makes Me OP even at Level 1" to align more with what the function actually does. 

[b]This mod controls how many times monsterdrop function runs when a monster is defeated granting player more drops.
[/b]
[b]Previous Formula -[/b] the monster drop determined the item that would be dropped and that picked loot drop item dropped based on configured amount.

[b]Updated Formula - [/b]The entire monster drop functions execute based on the configure set amount now, and so all other drop affecting items would apply to the drop which includes the newer books on monster drops, Luck, Wearing a Burglar ring, or a ring that combines with Burglar ring, etc.
